cases.explain: «сухая земля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

cases.explain: «Горячий песок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

cases.explain: «большая дорога» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.
